name: combo_slow
desc: The pink paint shark slowly swallows the muscular paint crocodile that is tightly hugging a small black witch cat: the crocodile squeezes the struggling cat in a firm bear hug as the shark jaws close over them inch by inch, goo and strings oozing from the shark mouth, then a big gulp and the shark body bulges with the shape of the two inside. Slow, heavy, gooey.
